units.source_text: 她说了句“来，把大家都叫来”，便传来了吧哒吧哒的脚步声，

en.t: She said, "Come, call everyone here," and at once the patter of footsteps could be heard,

units.source_text: 四五个少年走进客厅，以孩子的立正姿势排成一行。

en.t: Four or five boys came into the parlor and lined up in a row, standing at attention like children.

units.source_text: 他们是十一二岁到二十岁上下的青少年，好像都是弟子。

en.t: They were young people ranging from eleven or twelve to around twenty, and all seemed to be apprentices.

units.source_text: 其中夹着一位少女，她脸颊绯红，身体滚圆，但个子高大。

en.t: Among them was one girl, her cheeks flushed and her body round, though she was tall.
